description: Run ONE read-only SQLite SELECT (WITH … SELECT allowed) over the spreadsheet tables of the given contexts (see list_sheet_tables) and get the result as CSV with a header line: exact aggregates (SUM, COUNT, AVG, MIN/MAX), filters, GROUP BY, window functions, date()/strftime(). Only those tables are readable; writes, PRAGMA, ATTACH and other tables are refused. At most 200 rows / 20,000 characters (truncation is reported), 2 s time limit.

document_ids.description: Optional: only the tables of these documents (ids from list_documents).

name: query_table
